title: A study on coreflexive Banach Spaces
summary: In this paper, we study non-reflexive Banach spaces $X$ for which the quotient space $X^{**}/X$ is reflexive. Such spaces were first introduced by James R.~Clark, where they were called coreflexive spaces. We show that a space $X$ is coreflexive if and only if every separable subspace $Y\subseteq X$ is coreflexive, provided that $X$ is w$^*$-sequently dense in its bidual $X^{**}$. We show that coreflexive spaces are stable under $\ell^{p}$-sum for $1<p<\infty$.
